Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 3, Verse 10

“Having created humankind together with sacrifice, the Lord of creatures said long ago: By this you shall increase; let this be the cow that yields your desires.”

A creation story used as an argument. Reciprocity is presented as built into things from the beginning, not as a rule imposed later upon reluctant people.
